data.body: Investigation complete (ADVANCED, convergence_score=2). Both agents agree: schema correction sends the full original diff to Haiku on Strategy F paths. Haiku cannot reliably produce structured JSON on large inputs. Retry loop uses identical parameters (deterministic failure). Strategy F was added May 19 after schema correction was wired May 13, without updating the correction model. Fix: (1) strip diff from correction prompt for field-level errors, (2) upgrade correction model to Sonnet when Strategy F active.
